description: A Django replica of the Allotment and Gardening AllManiac blog, retaining its public reading experience, visitor post and comment submissions pending moderation, administrator approval/rejection/deletion, content import, visit tracking, and email notifications.

services.name: Django web application
services.description: Server-rendered Django site, application logic, and administration interface.

questions.question: Which language should the Django web application use?
questions.rationale: Django is a Python web framework, and the user explicitly requested a Django port.

questions.question: Which framework should power the web application?

options.label: Django
options.description: Python web framework with server-rendered pages and built-in administration.

questions.question: Which existing blog features should the Django port retain?
questions.answer: Retain all existing features: public blog reading; visitor post and comment submissions held pending moderation; administrator approval, rejection, and deletion; importing existing posts/content when available (otherwise start empty); visit tracking; and email notifications.
questions.rationale: The user requested all existing features and asked to import existing content when available.

questions.question: Which data and file storage should the project use?
questions.rationale: The user explicitly selected Turso rather than Azure PostgreSQL or SQLite. The blog serves images/media, so include Blob Storage for file storage while retaining Turso as the requested database.

options.label: Turso
options.description: Use the requested Turso/libSQL database for application data.

options.label: Blob Storage
options.description: Store and serve blog images and other uploaded media.

options.label: No datastore required
options.description: The application has no persistent database or file storage.

questions.question: Should ordinary visitors sign in to use the blog's application features?
questions.rationale: The existing public-facing submission and reading features are available to visitors without accounts; administrator access is separate.

options.label: Yes
options.description: Require visitor accounts/sign-in for application features.

options.label: No
options.description: Keep visitor reading and submissions public; protect administration separately.

contentImport: Import existing source content if available; otherwise start with an empty blog.
